DAT  
 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/SPECIAL CIVIL APPLICATION NO. 17378 of 2024  ==========================================================
 (MINOR) YAHYAKHAN S/O UBAIDULLAHKHAN INAYATULLAHKHAN  PATHAN THROUGH MOTHER  Versus  UNION OF INDIA  ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 ARBAAZKHAN A PATHAN (9532) for the Petitioner(s) No. 1  MR ARJUNDEV ZALA(10205) for the Petitioner(s) No. 1  KSHITIJ M AMIN(7572) for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANIRUDDHA P. MAYEE  Date : 05/02/2025

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
ORAL ORDER 1. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that by a communication dated 18.9.2024, the respondent has intimated that the father's consent is required for issuance of the passport to the petitioner, who is a minor- infant.

He submits that the parents of the minor are not living together and the mother of the minor has initiated criminal proceedings against his father and relatives under Sections 498A, 323, 294(b) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 7 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
He, therefore, submits that the father's consent cannot be obtained in such a situation.

3. Mr. Kshitij M. Amin, learned counsel appearing for the respondent submits that if the guardians of the petitioner cannot submit Annexure-D, then Schedule-III of the Passport Rules, 1980 provides for Annexure-C, which is a declaration by NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/17378/2024 ORDER (Minor) Yahyakhan S/O Ubaidullahkhan ... vs Union Of India on 5 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57874029/
1
DATED: 05/02/2025 undefined applicant's parent or guardian for issue of passport to minor when one parent has not given consent.
If one parent/ guardian submits Annexure-C, then application for issuance of passport of the petitioner can be processed further.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner shall submit Annexure-C as provided in Schedule-III of the Passport Rules, 1980 within a period of two weeks from today.
He submits that the passport application of the petitioner may be processed expeditiously.
5. In view of the aforesaid submissions, the petitioner is directed to submit Annexure-C as provided in Schedule-III of the Passport Rules, 1980 within a period of TWO WEEKS from today.
Upon receipt of the same, the respondent is directed to process the passport application of the petitioner being No.AH1060114455224 expeditiously within a period of FOUR WEEKS.
6. With the aforesaid directions, the present Special Civil Application is DISPOSED OF.

Sd/-
(ANIRUDDHA P. MAYEE, J.) OMKAR (Minor) Yahyakhan S/O Ubaidullahkhan ... vs Union Of India on 5 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57874029/
